mapper.select: select session_id, binding_id, state_seq, release_id, resource_version_id, page_no, student_can_browse, updated_at from edu_session_projection where session_id = #{sessionId}
mapper.insert: insert into edu_session_projection ( session_id, binding_id, state_seq, release_id, resource_version_id, page_no, student_can_browse, updated_at ) values ( #{sessionId}, #{bindingId}, #{stateSeq}, #{releaseId}, #{resourceVersionId}, #{pageNo}, #{studentCanBrowse}, utc_timestamp(3) )
mapper.update: update edu_session_projection set state_seq = #{stateSeq}, page_no = #{pageNo}, student_can_browse = #{studentCanBrowse}, updated_at = utc_timestamp(3) where session_id = #{sessionId}
